title: Crypto.AI.SharkTank
tagline: 🚀 CryptoSharkTank: Meet your AI-powered judging team! 🤖 Our 5 expert agents evaluate crypto projects on Team, Tech, Tokenomics, Market, & Community, saving VCs & hackathon judges time while helping teams refine their pitches. Smarter decisions, sharper pitches! 🌟
description:
CryptoSharkTank: AI-Powered Judging Meets Prediction Markets

CryptoSharkTank is an AI-driven platform designed to transform how crypto projects are evaluated. It streamlines the judging process for venture capitalists (VCs) and hackathon judges while providing project teams with valuable feedback to refine their pitches. The platform also includes a prediction market feature, allowing users to bet on which project the AI will select as the winner, adding an engaging and competitive layer to the experience.

The platform leverages five specialized AI agents, each focusing on a critical aspect of project evaluation: team and founders, technology and innovation, tokenomics, market potential, and community and ecosystem potential. These agents work collaboratively to analyze submissions, ask tailored questions to refine insights, and deliver detailed reports on strengths, weaknesses, and capital allocation recommendations. They each have an on-chain wallet pre-funded by VCs which allow them to "invest" in projects they would bring value, effectively turning them into on-chain fund managers and hedge funds.

Users can interact with CryptoSharkTank via the website or the Telegram Mini App, providing a seamless and mobile-friendly experience. The Telegram Mini App allows for quick project submissions, real-time updates, and easy access to AI-generated evaluations. This ensures participants and judges can stay connected and informed, no matter where they are.

With its AI-powered judging capabilities and engaging prediction market, CryptoSharkTank offers a unique solution to common challenges faced during hackathons and early-stage project evaluations. It saves judges and VCs significant time while providing teams with actionable feedback to improve their projects. Whether you're streamlining evaluations or betting on the next big crypto innovation, CryptoSharkTank makes smarter decisions and sharper pitches possible.
how_its_made:
CryptoSharkTank is an AI-powered platform built to streamline crypto project evaluations and introduce gamified prediction markets. 

The core system uses five domain-specific AI agents, enabled by Coinbase's AgentKit, for judging, real-time Q&A powered by XMTP messaging services, and transparent prediction markets Contract deployed on Eth/Base/Polygon. The platform includes a responsive web app built with React.js/Typescript and a Telegram Mini Web-App powered by Zircuit, ensuring seamless access and interaction. Coinbase Developer APIs and Blockscout Explorer provide on-chain data for tokenomics evaluation and transparency, while Scroll’s zkEVM enhances secure on-chain functionality.

Coinbase Developer Platform enabled advanced tokenomics analysis using blockchain data for accurate project evaluations. 
We use Dynamic wallet logins/connect to  ensure the project offers a user-friendly on-boarding/login experience suitable for mass adoption. Blockscout Explorer provided detailed on-chain data visibility, ensuring transparency in evaluation and predictions. 
XMTP powered interactive Q&A sessions between AI agents and project teams, enhancing feedback quality. 
Scroll enabled secure and scalable on-chain storage through zkEVM technology. 
Polygon facilitated a fast and cost-efficient prediction market for user engagement. 
Zircuit supported the creation of the Telegram Mini App, delivering a lightweight and intuitive solution for users. 
(We deployed on Eth Sepolia, Scroll Testnet, Polygon Mainnet, Base Sepolia, Zircuit Testnet, Morph Holesky, Flow EvM Testnet)
